answer: Emission dilution: the protocol mints a FIXED coin pool each epoch and splits it pro-rata across miners by verified work, not by account count. Register 1,000 sybil clones and each takes only 1/1,000 of the identical share — the vault's payout never expands, so duplication nets exactly zero. Extra identities merely thin the slice, like cleaving one quartz vein into a thousand chips; no hidden grove of bonus emission exists to harvest. Attacker cost: more reward demands more genuine work, never more wallets — sybil quantity is economically inert.
